newsitem.title: USA: DeVry student enrollment up 4.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: DeVry student enrollment up 4.3 pct.

text.p: DeVry Inc said Wednesday total student enrollment at DeVry Institutes for the 1996 fall term rose 4.3 percent to 30,585 from 29,333 a year ago.

This is the 18th consecutive term to exceed prior-year results in total student enrollment, it said. In the 1996 fall term, 8,572 new students enrolled, compared with 8,479 for the same term last year.

"Excellent U.S. recruiting results were affected by continuing below-normal results in Canada, which reflect the impact of earlier uncertainty regarding the availability of Provincial student aid for the fall class," said president Ronald Taylor.
DeVry owns and operates degree-granting higher-education schools.
